correctness.rationale: Headline: dual nodal quartic Gamma0 of topic S_nod (4Delta2, honeycomb-unimodular except central unit square P*=conv{(1,1),(2,1),(1,2),(2,2)}) has genus 3 with all edge weights 1, so by Lee-Len Lemma 2.9/Thm 4.4 all seven bitangent classes have multiplicity exactly 1; no multiplicity-2 class B0 exists at v0 or anywhere; target splitting law presupposing B0 is impossible as stated. Verified: (D1) P* normalized area 2, boundary 4, interior 0 by Pick, vertex weight 0, four length-1 edges => dual weights 1 — replayed PASS. (D2) explicit integer heights H0 make P* a lower-hull face with 14 unimodular triangles, tile area2 16 — replayed PASS via enumeration over all C(15,3) triples. (D3) general area count 8=n_tri/2+1 forces n_tri=14, V=15, E_bnd=12, E_int=(42+4-12)/2=17, b1=3; all weights 1 so paired graph Sigma=Gamma0 as graphs with g_Sigma=g_Gamma=3 (Lee-Len p.3: g_Sigma=(d-1)(d-2)/2=3) — replayed PASS. (D4) Lemma 2.9 fibers 2^{0}=1 ordinary / 0 special over 8 thetas => 7x mult-1 + 1x mult-0, max multiplicity 1 — full text of Lee-Len fetched and screened; arithmetic matches Thm 4.4 g=3 case. (D5) eps=1/10 refinements S_plus/S_minus are 16-triangle unimodular regular triangulations with genus-3 duals — replayed PASS. Admission's g=2 (1,2,2,2) pattern correctly identified as inapplicable: it requires genuine genus drop (I>0 or weight>1 edges), absent here. Caveat: dual_graphs.py used EPS=1 and produced a spurious extra parallelogram in S_plus/S_minus, so its bridge logs are illustrative only; verification-critical D5 rests on verify_disproof.py eps=1/10 which is correct. Proof distinguished from experiment: symbolic genus/multiplicity inference from cited theorem plus replayable enumeration. claim_route=TARGET audited normally; superseded target_exit.json grants no presumption.
